appointments.title: Assistant Director and Operations Manager, Geospatial Core Facility; Instructor, Department of Earth Sciences
bullets: Run day-to-day operations of the Geospatial Core Facility, which provides professional GIS services to the campus research community and external collaborators.
Non-tenure-track faculty member, Department of Earth Sciences.
Manage a $319,887 operating budget across four institutional indexes for a university recharge facility, where half of all revenue is now earned through billed services.
Oversaw billing growth of 181% in two years, from $44,530 in FY24 to $125,142 in FY26, with FY27 budgeted at $160,140.
Grew the facility's external client revenue more than sevenfold over three years, across municipal, federal, nonprofit, and private-sector clients.
Built and maintain the facility's central invoicing and rate infrastructure, and rebuilt the FY27 operating budget and service center rate template.

Teach GPHY 384/504, a co-convened undergraduate and graduate GIS and spatial analysis lecture with a separate graduate lab and recitation, and GPHY 484R Applied GIS and Spatial Analysis, a capstone with a semester-long client project.
Delivered 1,652 billable hours across 9 published service lines and 38 invoices to 25 clients in FY26.
Collect and process UAS imagery and LiDAR for research and client projects as a certified remote pilot.
Set published service rates across 9 service lines and prepared client quotes and scopes of work.

appointments.title: Executive Director
bullets: Directed a grassroots 501(c)(3) working in conservation and community development.

Led community-side negotiations with Sandfire Resources America toward a community benefits agreement for the Black Butte Copper Project, covering impact mitigation and long-term community investment.

Continued to help lead the negotiations as a board member after the executive director term. In March 2026 the parties announced a memorandum of understanding establishing a framework for a binding agreement, covering a community investment fund, a revolving loan fund, educational programming, and environmental stewardship.

appointments.title: Consultant
bullets: Led the organization's exploration of a community benefits agreement tied to Jervois Mining's Idaho Cobalt Operations, working the community side of the table.
Researched and advised on agreement structure, mechanisms, and initiatives toward a final agreement.
No agreement was reached. The developer suspended final construction in March 2023, after the engagement had ended.
